analysis.Transcript_Log:
Agent: Good evening, thank you for calling Duroflex.
Customer: Did I just speak to you right now?
Agent: You spoke to Kunal ji, tell me sir.
Customer: I am asking, what is the difference in material between Balance and Balance Plus?
Agent: Sir, in Balance Plus you get an additional layer of memory foam, that is the difference. And it is 8 inches thickness. And a Euro-top finish comes with it.
Customer: And the zone support and all that is in that too?
Agent: Everything is there sir. Memory foam and Euro top, that is the only difference.
Customer: Okay. And in 8 inches, does any other model come?
Agent: In 8 inches, our Posture Perfect also comes, which has pocket springs in the base with heat-away technology. Graphite strip is used in it.
Customer: That must be expensive.
Agent: Yes, that goes to approx 65,000 range. With that, a one-seater recliner comes complimentary.
Customer: The difference between Balance and this (Plus) is just memory foam and Euro top?
Agent: Euro top difference, sir.
Customer: What is Euro top?
Agent: It is a layer made... in the additional part... 
Customer: What difference does it make?
Agent: Just design-wise... look-wise it gets enhanced a bit better.
Customer: And memory foam, what thickness is it?
Agent: See, 2 inches thickness total if we talk about it. 6+2 we count it. Below is 6 inch base, above is 2 inch layer.
Customer: So then there is only 1 inch difference, what is the rest?
Agent: Yes sir. Overall if we talk, there is 1 inch difference in height.
Customer: So what material decreased in that? Or what increased by 1 inch?
Agent: Nothing, just the layer increased. In proportion... like I tell you, we have an 8 inch mattress, we don't count the quilt height. 
Customer: That is fine. I am saying in Balance, 2 inch memory foam minus happened, so 6 remained. So what is the remaining 1 (in the 7 inch one)?
Agent: See total overall if I talk about height, this comes to approx 8.5 inches, the Balance Plus. So just the top layer difference comes.
Customer: Top layer is 2 inches in this right?
Agent: Approx count, not exact.
Customer: If we remove the top layer, the bonded foam etc is equal in both?
Agent: Equal, equal in both. Everything is equal. Below bonded is there, above 5-zone orthopedic layer. And in Balance, in the top, memory foam quilting is found only. And in this (Plus), an additional layer is found.
Customer: Balance doesn't have memory foam?
Agent: No no no. It has it too.
Customer: What is not in it?
Agent: In Balance Plus there is memory foam sir. Both have it. In Balance, it is used only in the quilt (stitching with fabric). In Balance Plus, a separate layer is put, then the quilt is put.
Customer: Okay okay. 
Agent: I will send you photos of both, you can see.
Customer: Yes send it, send it.

analysis.Call_Summary: Customer called to check store closing time (9 PM) with an initial intent to visit immediately. She inquired about King/Queen mattress prices for back comfort. When the agent stated the starting price is ₹27,000, the customer's enthusiasm dropped significantly. She asked if there were 'local' (cheaper) options. The agent clarified it is a company outlet. The customer ended the call politely but indicated a mismatch in budget expectations.

1_Call_Objective.Objective_Phrase: Checking opening hours and Price Inquiry

3_Customer_Experience.Reason: Agent was polite and provided accurate information regarding time and price, but failed to handle the price objection or offer EMI solutions.

4_Funnel_Analysis.Reason: Customer knows she needs a mattress for back pain and is actively checking store hours and prices.
Timeline_to_Purchase_Reasons: Customer asked if the store is still open and mentioned she might be late, implying she is currently traveling or planning to go now.

6_Customer_Needs.Description: For Whom: Self/Family. Requirement: King or Queen size mattress. Specific Need: Comfortable and good for the back (Orthopedic). Constraint: Highly price-sensitive, looking for 'local' price range (likely under 20k).

Store_Visit.Reason: Agent confirmed the store is open till 9 PM but did not re-invite the customer after the price objection was raised.

Offers_Discounts_EMI.Comment: Missed opportunity to mention EMI when customer asked for cheaper options.

Brand_Legacy_Warranty.Comment: Agent clarified it is a 'Company Outlet' when asked about local goods.

E_Explore_Needs.Reason: Asked where she is coming from, but didn't dig deep into the back pain issue.

L_Link_Product.Reason: Provided a starting price range based on the size request.

A_Add_Value.Reason: Failed to add value (EMI/Offers) when price resistance occurred.

Main_Skills.Reason: Knew the starting price points immediately.

12_Agent_Evaluation.Reason: Did not attempt to negotiate, down-sell, or offer financing when the customer signaled the price was too high.

Emphasize the health benefits (Back support) over the price when the customer mentions comfort needs.

Customer: Okay okay, theek hai theek hai ji. (Okay okay, fine, fine sir.)
[Call Ends]
